signal_text: A blog post (dated March 24, 2026) by a seller described temporarily switching to Gumroad to start selling right away when Lemon Squeezy approval was pending, noting ease of setup and clean interface, but perceiving Gumroad fees as high, and subsequently migrating back to Lemon Squeezy once approved.
subject_exact: Seller-reported temporary Gumroad use due to ease of setup, with subsequent migration to Lemon Squeezy due to fee perception
extraction_notes: 'Fees felt a bit high' is subjective — no specific figure given. Lemon Squeezy named as destination. 'Start selling right away' contrasts with Lemon Squeezy approval requirement. March 2026.
